title: AliKit Data Grid matched revision comparison

benchmark.sample_order: Sorted values emitted by the benchmark; temporal order is not retained.
benchmark.measurement_boundary: TestUI full-turn elapsed time, direct elapsed time around data_grid() inside the application description callback, and Alicorn runtime CPU stages; excludes native renderer, GPU, presentation, and external accessibility clients.
benchmark.dependency_control: Both AliKit snapshots were compiled against the same current Alicorn and AccessKit revisions; this isolates AliKit source changes and does not compare each revision with its original lockfile stack.
